subject.name: Legal Studies
subject.textbook: CBSE Legal Studies XII textbook (074) – 8 units, ~13 chapters
subject.examPattern: CBSE Board exam, 3 h; SQP 2026-27 – 'no change in question paper design'. 50% competency-based, 20% MCQ, 30% SA/LA, ~33% internal choice. Theory 80 + Project 20. 40 questions: 20 MCQ×1, 8×2, 8×3, 4×5 (2025-26 SQP).
